report.thesis: The November 6 proxy supports at least 20,344,393 economic shares across legal common and two disclosed warrant holders. Georgia acceptance and collections determine how much of the five-year contract reaches those shares. If Axe makes twelve scheduled seller payments, $34.32M of the original face amount still comes due by September 30, 2027. Earlier cluster-secured financing accelerates payoff.
